analysis.how: Extractor builds the SymbolGraph, interpreter passes add semantics through pluggable providers, differ compares snapshots, all validated by the schema
analysis.name: Analysis Pipeline
analysis.what: Turns a repo into snapshots and deltas: static extraction, interpreter passes and diffing over one schema
analysis.when: Whenever scv analyzes or diffs a revision
analysis.why: Separates deterministic facts from interpreted meaning behind one data contract

cli.how: bin.ts dispatches commands over the pipeline and committed store; a build script copies skills into the package
cli.name: CLI and Packaging
cli.what: The scv command line and the build step that ships agent skills with it
cli.when: When users or CI run scv, and when the CLI is built
cli.why: One installable entry point for analysis, checks and repo setup

design-system.how: Token-styled components grouped by role and re-exported from one entry
design-system.name: Design System
design-system.what: CodeDream design tokens and React components used by the UI
design-system.when: Whenever the UI renders controls, panels or charts
design-system.why: Consistent visual vocabulary across every screen

fixtures.how: Python fixture code with cross-folder coupling, and Python tools that render the mock
fixtures.name: Fixtures and Prototypes
fixtures.what: The adversarial clustering fixture and the docs/mock prototype tools
fixtures.when: When clustering quality is evaluated or the mock is regenerated
fixtures.why: Test inputs and prototypes kept apart from product code

serving.how: Fastify routes read the .scv store; the viewer starts the API and serves the bundled UI with a proxy
serving.name: Viewer and API
serving.what: Serves snapshots over HTTP and hosts the built UI locally
serving.when: When a user opens the visualizer
serving.why: Keeps data serving separate from analysis and from the UI

tooling.how: ESLint and the Vitest workspace at the root, with per-package Vitest configs
tooling.name: Build and Test Tooling
tooling.what: Repo-wide lint and test configuration plus per-skin test configs
tooling.when: When npm run lint or npm run test runs
tooling.why: One lint and test policy for the monorepo

visualization.how: Layout computes one scene; skins render it through a shared contract inside the React app's canvas hosts
visualization.name: Visualization
visualization.what: The browser visualizer: layout engine, skin contract, 2D and 3D skins and the React app
visualization.when: Whenever a snapshot is explored in the browser
visualization.why: One layout, many presentations, never a fork per skin
